Chapter 1096: 23 Strength Transformation (Requesting Subscriptions)_3

Chapter 1096: Chapter 23 Strength Transformation (Requesting Subscriptions)_3

The expression of Xia Qin, the Supreme Being standing nearby, changed subtly.

“It’s nothing.”

Lin Yuan smiled and said.

Crossing into dominion through Path Splitting, is indeed an elevation of realm, and to be cautious, Lin Yuan dispersed most of the incarnations directly.

“Galaxy, what am I feeling?”

The Xuanyuan Supreme Being observed Lin Yuan more and more carefully, becoming increasingly astonished, and finally couldn’t help but ask.

Even though Lin Yuan tried his best to suppress his own aura, the Xuanyuan Supreme Being still vaguely perceived the changes in Lin Yuan before and after.

The oppressive feeling brought by the leap in the level of life and the qualitative change in strength made the Xuanyuan Supreme Being feel a deep awe.

“Just now, I went to make a breakthrough.”

Lin Yuan did not conceal anything and said directly.

The nine supreme beings of human civilization, including the Xuanyuan Supreme Being, could be trusted according to Lin Yuan, and he wouldn’t hide many things from them.

“A breakthrough?”

“Galaxy, you made a breakthrough?”

Xia Qin, the Supreme Being, was overjoyed. Lin Yuan is now the towering pillar of human civilization, his status surpassing the nine supreme beings.

The stronger Lin Yuan becomes, the stronger human civilization will be.

“A breakthrough? Galaxy, have you crossed into the dominion realm?”

The Xuanyuan Supreme Being’s tone was filled with emotion.

They had entered the twelfth stage hundreds of thousands of years before Lin Yuan, but now it hadn’t been long before Lin Yuan had completely surpassed them and crossed into the dominion realm.

This kind of surpassing is purely on a realm level.

As for combat power? The Xuanyuan Supreme Being and several other supreme beings suspected that even before Lin Yuan stepped into the twelfth stage, he had already exceeded some supreme beings in terms of combat strength.

“Galaxy, how strong are you now?”

Feather Butterfly Supreme Being was somewhat curious, and the other supreme beings were also curious.

In the universe, when Lin Yuan had just entered the twelfth stage of the Path Splitting Realm, the supreme beings had also asked this question.

At that time, the answer given by Lin Yuan was comparable to the peak of the Path Splitting Realm within the universe and comparable to the dominion realm outside the universe.

Now that Lin Yuan has directly crossed into the dominion realm, what level of actual strength has he reached?

“Equivalent to the Chaos Realm, I suppose.”

Lin Yuan said casually.

“Chaos Realm?”

Several supreme beings took a deep breath.

Even though they had some guesses before asking, hearing Lin Yuan admit it personally still made their hearts tremble uncontrollably.

Chaos Realm?

That is the realm of the Chaos Venerable.

Even in the Chaos Void, the Chaos Venerable ones hold a high position, for instance, the ‘Fragment World’ they are now in is just a small part of the Chaos Continent opened by the Ancient Ming Venerable.

“Does our human civilization also have a Venerable now?”

The Xuanyuan Supreme Being’s eyes faintly turned red, much like the other supreme beings.

The implication of Lin Yuan’s words was akin to the era when human civilization in the universe finally gave birth to the first supreme being after years of dormancy.

No, that’s not right.

The former is of far greater significance than the latter.

This is a Chaos Venerable.

In fact, what the Xuanyuan Supreme Being and the other supreme beings do not know is that.

What Lin Yuan referred to as ‘equivalent to the Chaos Realm’ actually means equivalent to the peak of the Chaos Realm.

The ordinary Chaos Realm and the peak of the Chaos Realm are two different concepts. Although the gap is not as large as that between a respected one and a Great Saint, the peak of the Chaos Realm is significantly superior to the ordinary Chaos Realm in terms of impact and strength methods.

This is still the strength of Lin Yuan’s newly advanced dominion realm, and as time progresses, Lin Yuan’s strength will enter a phase of continuous soaring.

…

After chatting with several supreme beings for a while,

Lin Yuan began a new round of seclusion.

“Entering the dominion realm, I can now cultivate the ‘Infinite Void’ Second Layer.” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

During the Path Splitting Realm, due to the low essence of life, even with the suppression of the Chaos Tree, it was impossible to master the ‘Infinite Void’ Second Layer. Now there is no longer such a restriction.

“‘Infinite Void’…”

Bits and pieces of the second layer of this thirteenth-stage inheritance flashed across Lin Yuan’s mind.

Given the current intensity of the cosmic foundation within Lin Yuan, once the ‘Infinite Void’ Second Layer is mastered, the internal universe will reach a level close to that of the Chaos Great Saint’s internal universe.

The Chaos Great Saints of the Chaos Void evolve a power path exclusive to themselves from within chaos, and the enhancement of their internal universe is extremely terrifying.

The aftereffects of a Chaos Great Saint’s casual movement are sufficient to seriously injure an ordinary Chaos Venerable; the contained essence is not only the comprehension of rules but also a vast magnitude surpassing that of a Venerable.

…

Internal universe.

The jade gourd trembled slightly, and the red-clad young girl condensed her form, her expression slightly amazed as she looked around.

The thirteenth-stage foundational inheritance ‘Infinite Void’ can indeed greatly enhance the internal universe of a living being, but someone like Lin Yuan far exceeded the young girl’s expectations.

The extent reached by Lin Yuan’s internal universe is mainly due to ‘Infinite Void’, but beyond this inheritance, many other reasons contributed.

“Who knows, it might really be possible to reach the seventh layer?”

The red-clad young girl thought silently in her heart.

‘Infinite Void’ has seven layers in total, among which the seventh layer is merely a theoretical realm. Once mastered, the internal universe will transform into an enormity comparable to the entire Chaos Void.

…

Deep in the Chaos Continent of Ancient Ming.

Ancient Ming Venerable’s brow slightly knit as he fell into thought.

“Ancient Ming, what’s happening?”

A black-robed youth emerged from the side, asking somewhat puzzled.

As a companion of Ancient Ming Venerable, the black-robed youth rarely saw Ancient Ming Venerable in such a state.

“Just now…”

Ancient Ming Venerable roughly explained what had happened earlier.

A presence suspected to be at the peak of the Chaos Realm, or a wondrous life-form of the Chaos Realm, had staged a spectacle of inhalation spanning hundreds of billions to trillions of light-years in the nearby Void Domain.

“To absorb Chaos Qi over such a vast area, it has to be either a Chaos Realm peak or a wondrous life of the Chaos Realm.”

The black-robed youth also made the same judgment.

“But it doesn’t really concern us, and recently I haven’t ‘foreseen’ any danger.”

The black-robed youth was somewhat puzzled.

“I speculate, the one absorbing a large range of Chaos Qi…”

Ancient Ming Venerable took a deep breath and then said solemnly: “It’s that ‘Galaxy’.”
